claim: Iter 137 P5 MIN-REPORT v2.2 cross-corpus portability audit (forced pivot from Pillar 4 / P5P8-SYNTH). Audits 18-item MIN-REPORT v2.2 schema against THREE distinct corpora in the worktree: C1=mega_20260704 (n=98 full manifests), C2=n10_seed_expansion (n=5 per-seed JSON partial), C3=n2_reward_tensor_resume (n=160 = 4 methods x 40 steps reward tensors only, NO manifest). Produces 3x18 = 54-cell applicability matrix with 6-mode encoding classification (EX explicit / IM implicit_filename / TS cells_tsv / TD tensor_derivable / NA n/a-sentinel / AB absent). H1 PASS — EX-mode counts are (mega, n10, n2) = (7, 2, 2); N2 ties N10 on EX because both emit group_size and zvf as bare fields. H2 PASS — KEY FINDING — RECOVERABLE counts (EX+IM+TS+TD) are (mega, n2, n10) = (13, 7, 3); N2 BEATS N10 on recoverable count despite having NO manifest — the reward tensor IS the source for Items 14, 15, 17 (TD mode per iter-113). H3 PASS — N2 has 11/18 items needing new emission; upgrade path concrete: emit a 9-key n2_manifest.json (model, temperature, decontam, sampler_backend, advantage_baseline, token_mask, kl_beta, heldout_split, reward_model_signature) to lift N2 from 7/18 to >=15/18. H4 PASS — 14/18 items have corpus-differentiated encoding mode (only 4/18 corpus-uniform: Items 3, 5, 10, 11). Median Shannon entropy per item = 0.355 (of log 6 max); max = 0.613 (Items 1, 8). Three structural patterns: (i) ZVF-derived items (13-17) are most portable — all 5 recoverable on mega and N2; (ii) Stack-axis items (1, 4) require filename regex — IM on mega, EX on N10, AB on N2; (iii) Schema-only items (3, 10, 11) are corpus-uniformly AB. Cross-paper coupling: (i) P5 iter-113 row 127a (content-layer; iter-137 extends to corpus-portability via TD); (ii) P5 iter-117 row 132 (structural-encoding on mega alone; iter-137 audits 3 corpora and shows encoding modes NOT uniform); (iii) P5 iter-121 row 137 (value-correctness; iter-137 adds portability); (iv) P5 iter-105 row 121 (per-value-class; iter-137 adds per-corpus dimension); (v) P6 iter-134 row 150 (P6 registry min_report block IS a 4th corpus of MIN-REPORT applicability; iter-137 framework extends to 4x18 grid in future synthesis iter); (vi) FRONTIER_INSIGHTS Round 2 (ZVF = signal availability; iter-137 confirms frontier synthesis: Items 13-17 are most corpus-portable because signal IS in tensor wherever tensor exists). Operational: (a) DOCUMENT corpus-conditional portability in paper_P5 sec:p5-iter137-cross-corpus; (b) ADD P6 registry as 4th corpus in future synthesis iter (4x18=72 grid); (c) EMIT n2_manifest.json to upgrade N2 (flagged not done in iter-137); (d) WIRE p5_iter137_corpus_x_item.tsv into MIN-REPORT CI gate (reject new corpus with <3 EX items). paper_P5_minreport.pdf rebuilds to 57 pages / 0 errors / 0 undefined citations (was 55, +2 pages from sec:p5-iter137-cross-corpus).
